answer: The bill comes first. One fake identity needs an aged account (~800 POA) plus a 200 POA bond locked 10 epochs: 1,000 POA for the first fake. Aged accounts are scarce, so the tenth costs 2,600 POA and a hundred run past 180,000 POA. A 10% spot audit each epoch checks a year of real transactions per anchor; a hollow anchor forfeits bond and badge. Each verified anchor wears a violet badge; a velvet rope admits only badged identities. Anchors sharing a funding source are slashed together, so bulk buying backfires — like a walnut, an anchor must crack open under audit and show real history inside.
